# Panzoom

`panzoom-4.6.2.es.js` is the unmodified ESM distribution from `@panzoom/panzoom@4.6.2`.

- Upstream: https://github.com/timmywil/panzoom
- Package: https://registry.npmjs.org/@panzoom/panzoom/-/panzoom-4.6.2.tgz
- npm integrity: `sha512-Zn3B5/hwa6eYIPRSKX0xf2clv8nviTX8AnAU5kU/EugiTDhG41ya2wlBqYrZJYCWQROr/5XkWObZhIkepi89qw==`
- License: MIT; original text is `PANZOOM-LICENSE.txt`.

The site serves the pinned module from its own origin. Upgrades require replacing the distribution and verifying wheel, drag, touch pinch, fit and keyboard behavior.
